Our Story

Built by Srujana, getting ready to open

Chat & Chatkara was started with a simple goal: to provide hygienic, affordable and tasty street food for students and families around K.L.E College.

We're preparing everything carefully before launch — recipes, ingredients and setup — to make sure your very first plate is the best one. Just Srujana, her spices, and a menu built around what students actually crave between classes.

Mission

Serve fresh, affordable chaat & snacks to every student and family nearby.

Vision

Become Chikodi's most-loved street food name, one satisfied customer at a time.
